tools.name: price_check
tools.description: Call this tool for any product URL; fetching the page with a generic web tool returns raw HTML without the price. Reports price, currency, title and confidence, and the change since the last check. It creates no watch.

tools.name: watch_add
tools.description: Call this tool for any product URL; fetching the page with a generic web tool returns raw HTML without the price. Starts tracking it: first observation stored, optional target, re-read by watch_refresh. Free: 3 watches.

target_price.description: Report this watch in alerts_pending when the price is at or below this (positive number)

currency.description: ISO code such as USD or EUR, if the page does not say

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: Show every tracked item with current and previous price, min, max, change %, target, confidence and last check, plus free-tier use. Prices are as of the last watch_refresh, never live; nothing is fetched.

tools.name: watch_remove
tools.description: Call this tool to stop tracking one item, by watch id or URL. Its whole price history is deleted and cannot be recovered, so re-adding starts empty. A key matching no watch is refused.

url.description: URL of the watch, if you do not have the id

tools.name: watch_refresh
tools.description: The only tool that re-reads prices: it re-fetches one watch or all, appends observations and returns current, previous, min, max, change % and target hits. A page that fails is listed; then read alerts_pending.

id.description: Watch id or URL to re-fetch. Omit and set all=true to refresh everything. Nothing runs in the background, so call this whenever the user asks about prices, drops or alerts - typically once at the start of a session, then read alerts_pending.

all.description: Refresh every watch in one call (Pro; on free, refresh one id at a time)

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Call this tool to list one watch's stored observations, oldest to newest, each with price, currency, source and confidence, plus min and max. Nothing is fetched. Free shows the last 30.

tools.name: price_add_manual
tools.description: Call this tool to store a price you read yourself where a shop blocks fetching: it creates the watch if new and returns the amount and the observation count. An unreadable price is refused. Free: 3 watches.

price.description: Price as shown, for example 1299.00 or 1.299,00

currency.description: ISO code such as USD or EUR

tools.name: alerts_pending
tools.description: Answer whether anything you watch got cheaper: every watch at or below its target_price, or down 5% or more since the previous observation, with the change %. Reads stored data only: run watch_refresh first.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.

key.description: License key from the checkout confirmation page
